field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable stunmesh-go for this WireGuard instance.

field.label: WireGuard instance
field.help: The WireGuard server instance (wgN device) to manage.

field.label: Protocol
field.help: Which IP families to use for STUN discovery on this interface.

field.label: Enable proxy
field.help: Front this interface with the stunmesh-go UDP proxy.

field.label: Proxy listen port
field.help: Outer-socket port for the proxy. Leave empty for an ephemeral port.

field.label: Proxy FIB
field.help: Routing table (FIB) number used as the escape route for the proxy. 0 disables the escape.

field.label: Underlay listen interfaces
field.help: Restrict which underlay interfaces STUN replies are captured on. Leave empty to listen on all eligible interfaces. Selected interfaces are mapped to their device names (e.g. igb0) in the generated config.

field.label: Also listen on default route interface
field.help: Additionally listen on the interface holding the default route.
